erratum.void_claim: 'Phase-transition thresholds are unreachable — cascades are dead code in current physics' (data/threshold_reachability.json, STATUS Measurement Era item 7)
erratum.why_it_was_wrong: thresholds.py:104 evaluates rule conditions on civ.forces[country_mask].mean(axis=0) — the NATIONAL AVERAGE. I measured the reachability of national means and reported it as the reachability of the mechanism.
erratum.corrected_reading: Cascades were never TESTED, not proven absent. Every rule is already satisfied by 1-29% of agents somewhere, today, with zero forcing. polarization_lock is 1.0% globally and 22.8% in one country — exactly the pocket structure national means erase.
erratum.also_void: the threshold_envelope 0.0089 displacement figure measures how little NATIONAL MEANS move under forcing; it says nothing about whether local pockets tip.

fix: detect_transitions evaluates conditions PER AGENT, then fires when the FRACTION of agents in a region meeting them crosses a critical mass. Critical fraction is a natural, non-arbitrary parameter; a fired region raises neighbours' fractions, so contagion can propagate.

MANDATORY TEST REGISTERED BEFORE THE FIX.warning_acknowledged: cascades appearing after the detector is changed prove NOTHING on their own — the detector was changed to make them possible.
MANDATORY TEST REGISTERED BEFORE THE FIX.arm_A_which: against real preference cascades with known timing (candidate set: Arab Spring 2011 by country, #MeToo 2017, same-sex-marriage tipping by country, Brexit/Trump 2016 polarization), does the fixed detector fire in the RIGHT regions? Threshold: precision AND recall > 0.5 on held-out regions.
MANDATORY TEST REGISTERED BEFORE THE FIX.arm_B_when: does firing timing correlate with observed timing (rank correlation >= +0.3)?
MANDATORY TEST REGISTERED BEFORE THE FIX.arm_C_specificity: does it stay QUIET where reality was quiet? False-positive rate on control country-years < 20%.
MANDATORY TEST REGISTERED BEFORE THE FIX.arm_D_not_a_knob: critical fraction fitted on a subset of cases must transfer to held-out cases without refitting.
MANDATORY TEST REGISTERED BEFORE THE FIX.failure_reading: fires everywhere = threshold too low, mechanism unfalsifiable, reject; fires nowhere = as before; fires but uncorrelated with reality = detector works, physics does not.

status: erratum recorded; detector fix and test to follow; production untouched until the test passes
